notes.title: Update! 30 New Pasaulio Pažinimas(World Knowledge) Levels and some bug fixes
notes.notes: [p]Whats done in this update ?[/p][p]30 new Pausaulio Pažinimas(World Knowledge)Levels for Lithuanian language[/p][p]and bug fixes[/p][p]bug fixes in 1 grade math levels[/p][p]select subject translated to english [/p][p]level 12  in English language question cloud was in Lithuanian[/p][p]level 17 in English language answers was in Lithuanian language[/p][p]level 20 in English language curency changed from euro to pounds[/p][p]level 24 in English language answers was in Lituanian language changed to English[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! 30 NEW MATH LEVELS!!!
notes.notes: [p]WHATS DONE ?[/p][p]Now you can choose with grade levels you wanna play and with subject for example first grade gonna have math, language and world understanding, later maybe gonna add more [/p][p]Done 30 math level for both English and Lithuanian languages[/p][p]Fixed problem entering levels room loading taking long, no its faster[/p][p]Fixed problem where playing Lithuanian levels you unlock levels in English language aswell[/p][p][/p][p]If you find bugs or have ideas how to make game better leave comment![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dev Update-POWER UPS, SAVE PROGRESS AND MORE!
notes.notes: [p]Happy to announce i added new things to the game here list [/p][p][/p][p][b]Save and load system- [/b] So now game gonna save and load progress automatically[/p][p][b]Power ups- [/b]added power ups freezing opponent snail, scaring with bird sound and wind[/p][p][b]Pressing wrong answer now gonna make snail move little bit back[/b][/p][p]fixed bug where player can start answering questions before countdown[/p][p][/p][p]if you find bugs or have ideas how to make game better leave comment![/p]

notes.title: Dev update-Snail Shop!
notes.notes: [p]New update![/p][p][/p][p]Now in game we have SNAIL SHOP where you can buy diffirent looking snails![/p][p]Done score(money) system everytime finishing level you will get 1 score(money) and you can spend that money on diffirent looking snails in future will add more stuff where you can spend in game money[/p][p]if you find bugs or have ideas how to make game better please comment :)[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update-Bugs fixed
notes.notes: [p]After game release find some bugs(Thanks to my assistant Amber😘) in the game here list of bugs fixed[/p][p][/p][p]bug fixes[/p][p]in Lithuanian levels fixed bug where instead of level 3 level 2 opens [/p][p]in Lithuanian level 28 fixed wrong answer clouds[/p][p]in Lithuanian levels fixed instead of level 30 open tutorial level[/p][p]in English level 11 fixed pepper cloud showing wrong cloud[/p][p]in English level 23 fixed when two answers left question cloud not created[/p][p]in English level 24 fixed creating same question cloud[/p][p]in English level 25 fixed footbal cloud too big [/p][p]in English level 29 fixed showing wrong question cloud and cloud size[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dev Update - 30 levels done! Whats next ?
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Im happy to share that the game already has [b]30  Lithuanian language fun and Unique levels ready to play![/b][/p][p][/p][p]But im just getting started-here whats coming next:[/p][p][b]power-ups[/b] to make races even crazier![/p][p][b]save and load[/b] system, so you can keep progress anytime[/p][p][b]diffirent snails skins[/b]-dress them up your way![/p][p][b]aquarium[/b]-where you can buy fish and decorate your aquarium how you like[/p]
